text:
alex: Heads-up — PR #2345 (migration guide + SDK snippet) is stuck in preview. Linkcheck and Vale failing on preview-ci. Anyone available to help triage? Preview: https://preview.redwood.ai/preview/2345
laura: I'll pick up linkcheck. Which anchors are broken? :coffee:
sam: I can run vale fixes; small phrasing rules triggered on code samples. Need me to push or you prefer me to open a tiny follow-up PR?
alex: Thanks — prefer fixes in same branch if small. CI shows 3 broken links and 2 vale alerts. Also md-lint line-length on code block.
ci-bot: Preview CI for PR 2345 — linkcheck: 3 errors, vale: 2 failures, md-lint: 1 violation. Logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/job/2345/1
maria: I rebased main into the branch earlier; might be why anchor IDs changed. If laura fixes links, I'll rebase after so preview URL updates.
tyler: To rerun preview use: `/docs rerun-preview 2345` — that'll queue fresh checks.
laura: Quick note — two of the three broken links are internal anchors that changed in the v2 migration. I'll patch to use new anchors and add redirects.
sam: I'll push Vale rule exceptions for the SDK snippet in a single commit and mark with `<!-- vale: disable -->` around the sample.
alex: Great. Who can run the preview rerun after fixes? We should aim to merge in the 4pm slot.
maria: I can trigger rerun + watch, but only after you push, laura + sam. If still failing, we might split link fixes first then vale.
ci-bot: Rerun queued by maria — job 2345-2
laura: Pushed link fix commit (squashed). PR updated.
sam: Pushed vale tweak and fenced disable. Also fixed line-length in code block.
ci-bot: Preview CI for PR 2345 (run 2) — linkcheck: 0 errors, vale: 0 failures, md-lint: 0 violations. All checks passed.
alex: Perfect. I'll merge in the 4pm merge window. Thanks all :tada:
tyler: If anything else blocks, ping me. I can help with backout plan.
alex: Merged. Closing thread.
